subject.title: [Feature]: Reply dispatch: replace scattered visibility inference with a settled-delivery turn ledger

question: Should core reply dispatch adopt a settled-delivery ledger as the canonical visible-turn contract, including a bounded settlement wait and a defined trust level for plugin-reported observed delivery?
rationale: This is a new cross-lane contract affecting fallback timing, transport settlement, and plugin-reported delivery; the merged predecessor intentionally deferred these design choices.

options.title: Sponsor the ledger contract
options.body: Define the canonical settlement boundary, timeout behavior, and plugin-observed-delivery semantics before accepting an implementation.

options.title: Retain targeted fixes
options.body: Fix demonstrated silent-turn cases individually without introducing a dispatch-wide ledger contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the ledger contract
recommendation.body: Define the canonical settlement boundary, timeout behavior, and plugin-observed-delivery semantics before accepting an implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the identifiable recent contributor to the merged fallback implementation and its documented follow-up design.
